verdict.rationale: Obsidian ships a first-party Templates core plugin that inserts pre-defined text snippets into the active note, which covers reusable templates for recurring note types. The pack does not show template variables (date, title) or templates applied automatically at note creation. Daily notes creates date-based notes, but nothing ties it to templates. missing for 10: documented template variables such as date/title, evidence of applying templates at note creation (e.g., Daily notes using a template), independent or hands-on corroboration
